name: Culinary Time VR
summary:
Culinary Time VR immerses you in the fast-paced world of a professional kitchen through virtual reality, where every decision matters. At the start, you set the number of diners and choose the recipes for your menu. The system automatically adjusts ingredient quantities and calculates costs, and you must adhere strictly to the preset budget with no possibility of overspending.
